title: JSON Lines record (v1)
description: One independent, compact, LF-terminated JSON object per line. The leading members are exactly schema_version, type, and command, followed by the record payload. Lines never contain headings, ANSI escapes, or any other human decoration; every line is independently parseable by a naive line reader.

oneOf.title: result record
oneOf.description: One logical search result in presentation order; per-command schemas pin the payload fields, including the explicit bucket or type and the original zero-based position. The web command's payload is pinned by web-result.schema.json, its multi-request pagination form by web-paged-result.schema.json, the context command's single-record form by context-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: paged result record
oneOf.description: One logical search result of a multi-request pagination run, carrying the page it came from beside its position; the web command's pagination payload is pinned by web-paged-result.schema.json, the news command's by news-paged-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: news result record
oneOf.description: One logical news search result in presentation order, including its freshness age; pinned by news-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: news paged result record
oneOf.description: One logical news result of a multi-request pagination run, carrying the page it came from beside its position and its freshness age; pinned by news-paged-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: videos result record
oneOf.description: One logical videos search result in presentation order, including its freshness age; pinned by videos-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: videos paged result record
oneOf.description: One logical videos result of a multi-request pagination run, carrying the page it came from beside its position and its freshness age; pinned by videos-paged-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: images result record
oneOf.description: One logical images search result in presentation order, carrying the result page url plus the full-size and thumbnail image urls; pinned by images-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: suggest result record
oneOf.description: One logical suggestion in presentation order, carrying the suggested query completion and the usable rich members; pinned by suggest-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: spellcheck result record
oneOf.description: One logical spellcheck correction in presentation order, carrying the spellcheck-corrected query; pinned by spellcheck-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: context result record
oneOf.description: The whole LLM context document as one logical result: the constant context bucket and the joined passage text of the usable grounding.generic entries; pinned by context-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: rich result record
oneOf.description: One vertical block of a rich callback response, labeled with the vertical's own upstream member name as its bucket; pinned by rich-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: places result record
oneOf.description: One logical place of a place search in presentation order, labeled with the response bucket it was enumerated from and its position inside that bucket; pinned by places-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: places details result record
oneOf.description: One requested POI id of a places details fan-out, at its original input position, present or placeholder; pinned by places-details-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: places describe result record
oneOf.description: One requested POI id of a places describe fan-out, at its original input position, present or placeholder; pinned by places-describe-result.schema.json.

oneOf.title: answers stream answer_delta record
oneOf.description: One increment of a streamed answers run; pinned by answers-stream-delta.schema.json.

oneOf.title: answers stream citation record
oneOf.description: One citation of a streamed answers run; pinned by answers-stream-citation.schema.json.

oneOf.title: answers stream entity record
oneOf.description: One entity of a streamed answers run; pinned by answers-stream-entity.schema.json.

oneOf.title: answers stream research_progress record
oneOf.description: One research-family event of a streamed answers run; pinned by answers-stream-research-progress.schema.json.

oneOf.title: answers stream upstream_event record
oneOf.description: One preserved upstream event of a streamed answers run; pinned by answers-stream-upstream-event.schema.json.

oneOf.title: warning record
oneOf.description: One advisory warning; the payload is exactly one nonempty message string.

oneOf.title: summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful stream; per-command schemas pin the payload fields. The web command's payload is pinned by web-summary.schema.json, its multi-request pagination form by web-paged-summary.schema.json, the context command's form by context-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: paged summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful multi-request pagination run; the web command's pagination payload is pinned by web-paged-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: news summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful non-streaming news search; pinned by news-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: news paged summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful multi-request news pagination run; pinned by news-paged-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: videos summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful non-streaming videos search; pinned by videos-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: videos paged summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful multi-request videos pagination run; pinned by videos-paged-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: images summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful non-streaming images search; pinned by images-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: suggest summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful suggest lookup; pinned by suggest-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: spellcheck summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful spellcheck lookup; pinned by spellcheck-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: context summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful non-streaming LLM context retrieval, carrying the snippet and source counts; pinned by context-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: rich summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful rich callback lookup, counting the vertical blocks and their total items; pinned by rich-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: places summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful place search, counting the places of every response bucket together; pinned by places-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: places details summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful places details walk, counting the ids, the returned and missing positions, and the chunk requests; pinned by places-details-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: places describe summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful places describe walk, counting the ids, the returned and missing positions, and the chunk requests; pinned by places-describe-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: answers stream summary record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a successful streamed answers run, carrying the observed usage at exact decimal scale or the cost-unknown marker; pinned by answers-stream-summary.schema.json.

oneOf.title: error record
oneOf.description: The terminal record of a failed stream; the payload is exactly the failure code, message, and retryability; a failed multi-request pagination run additionally reports its page counts, a failed streamed answers run its partial counts and its cost-unknown marker, and — exactly when the failing exchange observed a rate-limit snapshot — the observed quota windows ride last, in the same per-window rendering as the envelope's meta.rate_limits.

rate_limits.$comment: Present exactly when the failing exchange observed a rate-limit snapshot: for a 429, the windows that explain it; absent when the break predates any header observation (a transport-local break).

requested_pages.$comment: Present only for a failed multi-request pagination run: the page budget it was given.

received_pages.$comment: Present only for a failed multi-request pagination run: the pages completed before the failure.

requested_requests.$comment: Present only for a failed multi-request chunk fan-out: the chunk request count it was given.

received_requests.$comment: Present only for a failed multi-request chunk fan-out: the chunk requests completed before the failure.

deltas_emitted.$comment: Present only for a failed streamed answers run: the answer_delta records emitted before the failure.

citations_seen.$comment: Present only for a failed streamed answers run: the citation records emitted before the failure.

cost_unknown.$comment: Present only for a failed streamed answers run: true exactly when it ended without a final usage event, so an unreported cost never reads as free.
